source_snapshot.procedure: Changes programmable PMIC recovery, SPD/telemetry and I2C0-3 settings, then gives split 0:0:3 railtype3/voltagetype0/dimm0 lines, resets immediately and requests every DIMM with voltage types0/1.
source_snapshot.criteria: Uncorrectable tool PASS plus an OS report with no authoritative SWD deadline or electrical oracle.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; shared PMIC words do not establish the SWD physical rail, selected comparator or recovered target.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Preserves serialized railtype3 coverage but lacks register proof, PMIC address ownership, SWD limits and a signed recovery plan.

old_problem: One ambiguous seed tuple cannot establish all-DIMM/two-comparator coverage; railtype3=SWD, voltage selector meanings, PMIC/I2C topology, command continuation, rail-specific PASS evidence and memory recovery are missing.
disposition_reason: The SWD fatal purpose is clear, but its OEM rail selector and electrical effects cannot be inferred from adjacent PMIC cases. Under ED-03/12/15/16, execution and PASS remain blocked until vendor command semantics, electrical boundaries and recovery authority are approved.
decision_basis: Directly read Reliability row91 and historical record2489; separately checked SWC row90 and VIN-Bulk row92 identities.
Preserved railtype3, voltagetype0/1, every DIMM, immediate reset, I2C/SPD settings and OS reporting.
Required an addressable physical target matrix rather than extrapolating dimm0/UMC3.
Made the SWD status bit/telemetry channel and restored memory training part of the oracle.
Performed no DUT access, PMIC write, injection, reset, retry or recovery.

test_case.test_name: DDR5 PMIC SWD fatal rail recovery matrix
test_case.purpose: Prove an authorized fatal condition is injected on SWD—not another PMIC rail—for each mapped DIMM/comparator, observe the specified reset and durable report, then verify rail-D and memory service are fully restored.
required_package: Signed PMIC register definition for railtype3=SWD and both voltage selectors
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller, bus and OOB ownership map
Vendor-correct single-line command and enumerated target list
SWD nominal/tolerance/current/thermal envelope, status oracle and recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: Execution is prohibited while the split syntax is unresolved. After approval, baseline SWD voltage/status, SPD/I2C settings and memory; inject exactly one mapped railtype3 comparator under OOB capture; confirm fresh SWD status/reset evidence; restore the rail and management configuration and validate all DIMMs before releasing the next tuple.
test_case.expected_result: The selected physical PMIC alone records the expected SWD fatal status, the host follows the approved reset-to-OS-ready path, and post-recovery SWD telemetry, DIMM enumeration/training, bounded memory result and configuration diff all meet the signed limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact SWD register/address identity, comparator proof, fresh durable source fields and complete electrical/memory restoration. A generic PMIC message, another rail bit, unsafe telemetry, ambiguous target, lost DIMM, missed deadline or configuration drift is FAIL/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Instrumented isolated DDR5 system with independent OOB and a tested no-boot/DIMM-loss recovery route.
Authorize one PMIC and one comparator per run.
Stop on unexpected status, electrical/thermal excursion, I2C loss, abnormal reset or memory-training failure.
No loop, automatic reset, retry or progression.
expected_evidence: Pre-run SWD electrical, SPD, I2C and memory baseline
Exact injected tuple with OOB reset/boot chronology
Fresh SWD PMIC and CPER/BERT/SEL source/severity evidence
Restoration diff, rail readings, complete DIMM training and bounded memory evidence
test_case.recovery: Reapply the approved PMIC mode/recovery, SPD host-control, telemetry, I2C and BIOS/HDT baseline; retrain and enumerate all memory, then run the bounded health check. Use the signed OOB/firmware/hardware recovery path for no-boot or a missing DIMM.

source_conflict.reason: The all-DIMM/dual-voltage demand remains incompatible with the sole fixed tuple and undefined line continuation; rail-specific acceptance is also absent.

blocked.reason: Wrong-rail fatal injection or incomplete SWD restoration can destabilize DDR5 power and prevent subsequent boot or memory training.
